items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the pianist who recorded the Flute Adaptations, the Rachmaninoff, and that Samuel Barber

ctx.x: Now are you going back – it sounds like most of these are jazz engagements. Are you doing any more classical? Or we can call it classical. I always say concert music.

They’re working on it, because you know this Yayoi [Yashida], the pianist who recorded the Flute Adaptations, the Rachmaninoff, and that Samuel Barber. She has strong interests for us in Japan, to play some venues, just the two of us. I don’t know how they’re going to work that out, because when we recorded, we actually sweetened up some of the stuff. But they have strong interest for that as well. So we may be doing something behind that. But right now, no, there’s nothing scheduled.
Any more engagements coming up with Chick? Because that seems to be a . . .
